svg.title: Ask the tutor: answers come from retrieved material, with links
svg.text: Ask the tutor: answers come from retrieved material, with links
Any question, any time. The answer is paraphrased from the course material and cited, or the tutor says the material does not cover it.
Student
the chat panel in the shell
Server and orchestrator
server.py, retrieval.py
Tutor model
anthropic, claude_code, ollama, or mock
1 the question text, and the unit on screen
2 Retrieve, in code
retrieval.py: lexical search over the knowledge
base, top 3 chunks, source text ranked first;
plus the unit on screen and recent chat turns
3 qa.md: the chunks, each with its source and link,
and the earlier turns (context, not a source)
4 a cited_answer block, streamed as written
5 the answer streams in, each source as a link
When the material does not answer
The model sets in_corpus to false and says the question is
not covered. It does not reason its way to a rule.
No match and no web search: the server says so itself,
without a model call.
Web search, a fallback that is off by default
Only on the anthropic backend, when supports_web_search is
true. Results are labelled as web sources; FAA and CFR
sources still outrank them, and every claim keeps its link.
Earlier chat turns are context only, never a source.
